summary: The session discusses the concept of analytical franchises and how generative AI is transforming analytics delivery. It emphasizes the need for a balanced organizational model that combines centralized governance with decentralized execution to enhance efficiency and responsiveness to business needs. The speaker advocates for co-ownership and collaboration between IT and business teams to foster a data-driven culture and improve analytics outcomes.

key_points: Generative AI is changing how analytics is delivered.
There is a need for new operating models to meet evolving business expectations.
Finding a balance between centralized governance and decentralized execution is crucial.
Analytics should be treated as a team sport requiring diverse skills.
Start with a small central team to define standards and iterate.
Variable mandates allow franchises to operate at different levels of autonomy.
Data products and analytics products provide structure and improve quality.
User experience is critical for effective data consumption.
Empower business teams as franchise owners of their data.
Foster collaboration and acknowledge varying capabilities among franchises.

key_takeaways: Adopt a franchise model to balance central governance with local autonomy.
Encourage collaboration between IT and business teams to enhance analytics effectiveness.
Implement data products to improve structure and quality in analytics delivery.
